what.text: The company operates in the retail sector, focusing on lifestyle brands and food businesses. It aims to enhance customer experience through innovative store designs and a strong digital presence.

segments.name: Lifestyle Retail
segments.text: This segment includes a portfolio of lifestyle brands that cater to consumer preferences. It aims to build a compelling brand image and address substantial market opportunities.

segments.name: Food Business
segments.text: The food business focuses on tight footprint stores with a curated selection of merchandise and a growing proportion of own-branded offerings.

segments.name: Digital and Omni-Channel
segments.text: This segment enhances customer engagement through digital platforms, contributing to around 6% of revenues.

segments.name: Supply Chain and Logistics
segments.text: The company invests in scaling and upgrading its supply chain network to support sustainable long-term growth.

segments.name: Information Security
segments.text: The company implements a structured approach to managing information assets through an Information Security Management System.

guidance.question: Without explicit guidance, how can investors assess management's credibility in delivering on strategic goals?
guidance.answer: Investors can assess management's credibility through financial metrics such as revenue growth, net profit growth, and operating margins. For instance, the revenue CAGR is 34.5% over three years and net profit CAGR is 63.5% over the same period, indicating strong performance. Additionally, operating margins have improved from 4.4% in FY21 to 19% in FY26, reflecting operational efficiency.
